entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, pulling that up now... VF88602. I see an order for the Velo Carbon cycling shoes, delivered on November 8th. Is that correct?
Okay. To understand how to best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
I'm sure they're perfect for someone else, but they're not for me. I've tried everything, adjusted the cleats a dozen times, and all I got for my trouble were blisters.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key, and it sounds like these weren't the right fit for you at all. I'm just checking our return policy here.
I'm sure you have a policy. I just want a refund.

Of course. And good news, I can definitely process that for you. I see your purchase was 41 days ago, and our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days. We can absolutely get you a full refund.
Fine. Whatever. What do I do?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You'll just need to box up the cycling shoes, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Got the email. So that's it?
That's it. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find a better product for you in the future. Have a good day.
